name: Diavgis — Greek public procurement, OCDS 1.1
description: Διαύγεια, ΚΗΜΔΗΣ and EU TED acts, linked into contracting processes and expressed as OCDS 1.1 releases.

organizationIdentifierScheme.note: org-id.guide has no list for the Greek ΑΦΜ or ΓΕΜΗ. ΑΦΜ is used because it is the only identifier carried by BOTH contracting authorities and suppliers in Greece — public bodies are not registered in ΓΕΜΗ.

endpoints.releasePackageByDayPaged: https://api.diavgis.gr/ocds/releases/{YYYY-MM-DD}?cursor={cursor} — do not construct this by hand: follow links.next

coverage.note: Greek sources publish long after the issue date: the measured mean gap between issue and publication is 8-10 days and most of a day's acts arrive more than 4 days late. Days on or before settledTo are complete and cached for a week; later days are still filling and are served with a short cache. Re-crawl anything after settledTo.

notes: value uses the GROSS basis coalesce(amount_gross, amount_net): Διαύγεια publishes one VAT-inclusive figure, so amount_net is only genuinely net on ΚΗΜΔΗΣ rows.
Acts whose counterparty is a natural person are GDPR-redacted at source and carry no supplier party.
A day package holds 1000 releases; when more exist, links.next points at the following page (OCDS pagination extension).
Each Diavgis chain is one contracting process, so a process carries one award and one contract, whose ids are derived from the ocid.
